title: Named LF validation lane and scoped round-robin replay
failure_signature: Inherited validation attempts exposed missing Git indexes, checkout newline conversion, long-path checkout failure, hash-domain confusion, and stale integrity receipts.
trigger_preconditions: non-Eiren phase under the scoped validation rule
candidate_workaround: Use a fresh clean named Ilyra validation branch and LF-preserving D-first worktree at the exact final head, run only the frozen scoped checks, keep Git-blob and logical-text hash domains distinct, and leave the canonical sequential branch authoritative.
recurrence_guard: Forbid detached validation, full-suite ownership by this seat, raw working-tree byte claims for logical text, any second additional replay, and any push from the validation lane.
rollback: Stop using the named validation lane, retain its failed receipt, and return to the clean canonical Ilyra branch without deleting, resetting, or rewriting another lane.
scope_boundary: Candidate workflow only until the one authorized final named-lane replay passes; never independent reproduction, exhaustive validation, or scientific evidence.
